motion.name: button-transition
motion.value: color .18s ease, background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary operator action; example is visual only.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Aptos',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--primary,#5145cd);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;color:#fff;background:var(--primary,#5145cd);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}.ds-primary:hover{border-color:var(--primary-hover,#4035ae);background:var(--primary-hover,#4035ae)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#5145cd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Secondary action on a white surface.
components.css: .ds-ghost{font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Aptos',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--border-bright,#c6cbd8);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;color:var(--muted,#626b7e);background:var(--surface,#fff);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}.ds-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-2,#f0f2f8)}.ds-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#5145cd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-ghost:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-ghost:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ghost{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Selected navigation item
components.description: Sidebar navigation retains icon and label in compact layouts.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-nav button{font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Aptos',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:44px;display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--muted,#626b7e);background:transparent;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--text,#202637);background:var(--surface-2,#f0f2f8)}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{color:var(--primary,#5145cd);background:var(--primary-tint,#f0effc)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#5145cd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-nav button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-nav button{flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:10px 3px;justify-content:center}.ds-nav span{font-size:11px;text-align:center;line-height:1.4}.ds-nav svg{width:19px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav button{gap:3px;padding:5px 2px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

narrative.overview: PayMender uses a light payment-operations interface: white surfaces, a cool neutral canvas, indigo actions and compact, labelled case information. The hierarchy supports scanning a portfolio, inspecting evidence and making an explicit decision.
keyCharacteristics: labelled navigation at every supported size
dos: Do use the existing neutral and indigo tokens for surfaces, actions and selection.
Do retain text labels and counts alongside status colors.
Do preserve visible focus, responsive navigation labels and reduced-motion handling.
Do keep estimates, synthetic results and confirmed payment evidence visibly distinct.
donts: Don't turn a created payment link or a charged subscription into an attributed recovery claim.
Don't copy competitor branding, proprietary assets or sample performance figures.
Don't present this extracted system as a user-approved visual comp or a permanent preference beyond this project.
